part.text:
Build passes. `/catalog` is a partial prerender, so default link prefetching only fetched the static shell — the category heading/products were still fetched after the click, showing the fallback.

Change in `app/page.tsx:15`: added `prefetch={true}` to each category link. This fully prefetches each `/catalog?category=...` URL's RSC payload (heading + products) into the client router cache when the link enters the viewport, so the click renders instantly from cache — no loading state, no server render at click time. URLs are unchanged.
